comment: Seam between the CLIs (Stage 1 bin/, Stage 2 pdf2md) and the Obsidian plugin (Issue #55). Both test suites read this file; docs/cli-contract.md explains it.

pageCases.comment: Issue #140: the review view spawns `pdf2md <args>` from the vault root, with the preview's vault-relative path. It relies on the exit code (success; anything else is a failure whose reason is the last stderr line) and reads the case lines from stdout: `add` prints the line of the case it wrote, `list` one line per case of the preview. Every other stdout line is human text.

installationCheck.comment: Issue #28: Settings -> Check installation spawns `pdf2md <args>` from the vault root with the preview folder. It relies on the exit code (success or check-failed) and shows every output line as it is.
